autocorrect_text_bug.definition: Complaints about the iOS keyboard/autocorrect bug that mangled the letter 'i' (a real, documented iOS 11.1-era defect).
autocorrect_text_bug.include: Message mentions the corrupted 'i' character, 'autocorrect', or describes the keyboard glitch.
autocorrect_text_bug.exclude: General typing complaints unrelated to the specific 'i' bug.

account_security_icloud.definition: Login, Apple ID, iCloud, password, or account-security/lockout issues.
account_security_icloud.include: Mentions iCloud, Apple ID, password, login, 2FA, or account being locked/hacked.
account_security_icloud.exclude: Purchase/billing issues tied to an account (goes to billing_repair_order).

billing_repair_order.definition: Refunds, incorrect charges, orders, warranty, repairs, or replacements.
billing_repair_order.include: Mentions refund, charge, order, warranty, repair, replacement, return, Genius Bar.
billing_repair_order.exclude: General battery or screen complaints with no billing/repair request.

battery_power.definition: Battery drain, charging problems, or device not powering on.
battery_power.include: Mentions battery, charging, draining, or the device failing to turn on.
battery_power.exclude: Device turning off/crashing without a battery/charging cause (device_not_working).

screen_hardware_damage.definition: Cracked, broken, or malfunctioning screen/display or physical buttons.
screen_hardware_damage.include: Mentions screen, crack, display, Touch ID/Face ID, stuck buttons, water damage.
screen_hardware_damage.exclude: Software-only display glitches with no hardware damage implied.

connectivity.definition: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular signal, or hotspot connection problems.
connectivity.include: Mentions wifi, bluetooth, signal, cellular, hotspot, or 'won't connect'.
connectivity.exclude: App-specific connectivity (e.g. one app not loading) with no network complaint.

ios_software_update.definition: Problems following or caused by an iOS/software update.
ios_software_update.include: Mentions update, iOS version numbers, software, reinstalling.
ios_software_update.exclude: The specific autocorrect 'i' bug (its own category).

app_appstore_media.definition: Issues with the App Store, iTunes, Apple Music, or a specific app/download.
app_appstore_media.include: Mentions App Store, iTunes, Apple Music, an app, or downloads/podcasts.
app_appstore_media.exclude: OS-level update issues with no specific app mentioned.

device_not_working.definition: Device frozen, crashing, restarting, or generally unresponsive, without a clear battery/screen/connectivity cause.
device_not_working.include: Mentions frozen, crashing, not responding, bricked, dead.
device_not_working.exclude: Cases already covered by a more specific category above.

other_unclear.definition: Everything that doesn't match a rule above: vague complaints, off-topic mentions, single-word replies, or messages needing more context.
other_unclear.include: No keyword match from any rule above.
